prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1350; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Claimant reports being the driver of the vehicle struck on the passenger side. Initial contact made by phone. Claimant states they were proceeding through on a green signal when the other vehicle entered the intersection. No police report number provided yet; claimant says an officer responded to the scene and will be requested.

Entry 2: Claimant reports left knee pain from striking the door column and dashboard area during impact. Claimant states they were not transported by ambulance but were seen at an urgent care facility later the same day. Claimant has not yet provided medical records. Advised claimant of the need to submit treatment documentation and provided a list of required items by mail and email.

Entry 3: Recorded recorded statement from claimant regarding the sequence of events. Claimant describes the other vehicle failing to yield on the left turn and striking the driver side front quarter panel of the claimant's vehicle. Claimant reports no airbag deployment on their side. Photos of vehicle damage requested; claimant indicates they will upload images through the online portal within the next few days.

Entry 4: Claimant is not represented by an attorney and has stated they are handling the claim directly. Explained the general claims process, the timeline for reviewing injury documentation, and that the claimant may request a copy of the file at any time. Claimant asked whether a rental vehicle is covered; advised that rental coverage depends on the policy terms and that the policy declarations page will be checked for this.

Entry 5: Follow-up call placed to claimant to confirm receipt of photos and status of medical visit. Claimant reports ongoing knee stiffness and difficulty bending the joint, and has scheduled a follow-up appointment with their primary care provider. Vehicle is currently at a repair shop pending a damage estimate. Claimant was advised that the file will remain open pending receipt of the medical records and the repair estimate, and that a further update will be provided once those items are reviewed.
